title: My voice
subtitle: Choose here who tells the stories.

own.waitingNote: The recording was not sent. Delete it and record again; this does not use up a new voice.

add.full: You cannot record a new own voice right now.

narrators.hint: Tap a narrator to add it to your list.
narrators.pickHint: Add a narrator to listen to the story. You return to the story once it is added.
narrators.slotsFull: Your list is full ({{used}}/{{limit}}). Remove one to add a new narrator.
narrators.empty: The narrators could not be loaded right now. Pull down to refresh.
narrators.emptyLanguage: There are no {{language}} ready-made narrators yet.

delete.title: Delete the voice {{name}}?
delete.messagePlain: Your recording and the voice made from it are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
delete.messageLeft: Your recording and the voice made from it are deleted for good. This cannot be undone. Deleting does not give back the new voice you used. You have {{left}} new voices left this month.
delete.messageLeftLifetime: Your recording and the voice made from it are deleted for good. This cannot be undone. Deleting does not give back the new voice you used. You have {{left}} new voices left, and they do not renew.
delete.messageFinal: Your recording and the voice made from it are deleted for good. This cannot be undone. Deleting does not give back the new voice you used. You have no new voices left, so after a delete you cannot record again.
delete.messageFinalMonth: Your recording and the voice made from it are deleted for good. This cannot be undone. Deleting does not give back the new voice you used. This month's are used up, so after a delete you cannot record again before the new month.
delete.messageNoRefund: Your recording and the voice made from it are deleted for good. This cannot be undone. Deleting does not give back the new voice you used.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.message: The narrator leaves your list. You can add it again whenever you like.

retry.title: Start over
retry.message: The voice {{name}} could not be prepared. You can delete this recording and read again.

retryPending.message: The recording of {{name}} was not sent. Delete it and read again.

toasts.addFailed: The narrator could not be added
toasts.previewFailed: The sample could not be played

catalogue.errorTitle: The narrators could not be loaded
catalogue.errorMessage: Check your connection and try again.
